all_entries.first_tokens: ttsSpeed set to always 1.0 — removed sub-1.0 speeds for A1/A2/VI levels. Root cause: aura-2-zeus-en with MP3 encoding produces choppy artifacts at speed 0.85.
agentGreetingSent flag added — guards against duplicate InjectAgentMessage on SettingsApplied. Prevents two OBIs speaking at once from reconnect race.
agentInjectInFlight flag added — prevents silence timer firing InjectAgentMessage while another inject is still in-flight. Cleared on inject completion, barge-in, and WS drop.
Re-entrant guard in playAgentChunk — prevents concurrent Audio elements from playing simultaneously when multiple code paths call playAgentChunk.
Audio queue cap raised from 30 to 100 with uniform cap enforcement across both accumulation and direct push paths. Fixed truncation of long audio responses mid-sentence.

navigator.mediaDevices guard in startAgentListening() — shows 'Mic not available in this browser' instead of silent crash in in-app browsers. 12s stale connection timeout updates 'Connecting...' to actionable error.

7 new EC-dualaudio lock tests added: agentGreetingSent presence, guard in handler, agentInjectInFlight silence timer guard, flag reset on drop, re-entrant guard, queue cap, barge-in clear. 20/20 PASS.
